info.title: alertcenter
info.description: Report application incidents and use a personal API key to view and handle incidents across authorized AlertCenter applications.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

commands.name: report
commands.description: Report a GitLab pipeline result; count failures and mitigate recovery using incident metadata.

options.name: --server
options.description: AlertCenter server base URL.

options.name: --api-key
options.description: Application API key for this invocation. Never saved.

options.name: --json
options.description: Write the complete AiurProtocol response as JSON. [default: False]

options.name: --result
options.description: Pipeline result: success or failed. Pipeline identity is read from GitLab CI environment variables.

commands.name: personal
commands.description: View and handle incidents across applications with a personal API key.

commands.name: list
commands.description: List incidents across applications you can handle.

options.name: --server
options.description: AlertCenter server base URL.

options.name: --api-key
options.description: Personal key. Defaults to ALERTCENTER_PERSONAL_API_KEY. Never saved.

options.name: --json
options.description: Write the complete response as JSON. [default: False]

options.name: --status
options.description: active (default), all, new, mitigated, or resolved. [default: active]

options.name: --level
options.description: Filter by sev0 through sev4.

options.name: --mine
options.description: Show only incidents assigned to you. [default: False]

options.name: --all-visible
options.description: Also include applications where you only have view access. [default: False]

options.name: --json
options.description: Write the complete response as JSON. [default: False]

options.name: --id
options.description: Incident ID.

options.name: --page
options.description: Timeline page. [default: 1]
